title: Setting Up Vue Router
description: Install and configure Vue Router in your Vue 3 app.

slides.title: Installation
slides.content:
# Install the Package

In a Vue project (created with Vite or Vue CLI):

```bash
npm install vue-router@4
```

Or with CDN:
```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/vue-router@4"></script>
```

slides.title: Basic Setup
slides.content:
# Create the Router Instance

```javascript
// router.js
import { createRouter, createWebHistory } from 'vue-router'
import Home from './views/Home.vue'
import About from './views/About.vue'

const routes = [
  { path: '/', component: Home },
  { path: '/about', component: About }
]

const router = createRouter({
  history: createWebHistory(),
  routes
})

export default router
```

Then in `main.js`:
```javascript
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import App from './App.vue'
import router from './router'

createApp(App).use(router).mount('#app')
```

quizData.question: Which function is used to create the router instance in Vue Router 4?
quizData.explanation: Vue Router 4 uses `createRouter` to create the router instance, which accepts a history mode and routes array.
